manifest.title: opendesk
manifest.author: Marcus Quinn <marcus@marcusquinn.com>
manifest.description:
opendesk is an open-source helpdesk. Support email and live chat arrive as
tickets in one shared inbox, updated live for the whole team, alongside a
public help center, automations, SLAs and reports.

### Features

* **Shared inbox** for email and chat: assignment, teams, labels, custom
  fields, internal notes, saved replies and views.
* **Live chat widget** for your websites, in 13 languages.
* **Help center:** a public knowledge base with articles in collections.
* **Automations and SLAs:** rules that route, tag, escalate and reopen
  tickets; response targets with business hours.
* **Reports** on ticket volume, solve rate and satisfaction surveys.
* **Optional AI** drafts, summaries and translation with your own Anthropic,
  OpenAI or OpenRouter key. Off until a key is set.

### Cloudron integration

* **Single sign-on:** Cloudron users sign in with their Cloudron account.
  Password registration is off by default.
* **Outgoing mail:** sign-in links, invitations and notifications go through
  the Cloudron mail relay.
* **Mailboxes on Cloudron Mail:** connect a support address hosted on this
  Cloudron with its password. The server settings fill in, and the connection
  stays on the internal network with TLS verified.
* **Backups:** the PostgreSQL database and attachments are in Cloudron backups.

Receiving mail by forwarding to opendesk is not available in this package; use
IMAP (Email password) instead.

[opendesk](https://github.com/useopendesk/opendesk) is open source under the
Apache-2.0 licence. This package is maintained independently of the opendesk
project.
manifest.tagline: Open-source helpdesk: shared inbox, live chat and help center
manifest.postInstallMessage:
opendesk is running. Open the app and sign in.

<sso>
Choose **Continue with** your Cloudron. Every Cloudron user allowed by this
app's access control can sign in; the first one creates the workspace and
invites the team.

To open the instance admin panel (`/admin/`), grant yourself admin in the app's
Terminal:

    opendesk-cli admin grant you@example.com
</sso>

<nosso>
Password registration is off by default. Set `SIGNUP_ENABLED=true` in
`/app/data/env`, restart the app, create your account, then turn it off again
and invite the rest of the team from opendesk.
</nosso>

**Support mailbox on Cloudron Mail:** create the mailbox (and any aliases) in
Cloudron, then in opendesk open **Settings → Mailboxes → Add mailbox**, enter
the address, choose **Email password** and enter its Cloudron password. The
IMAP and SMTP settings fill in automatically.

Settings live in `/app/data/env`. Keep backups: `/app/data/.secrets.env` holds
the key that decrypts stored mailbox passwords.

Setup guide: [README](https://github.com/marcusquinn/cloudron-opendesk-app/blob/main/README.md).
manifest.changelog:
* Initial package of opendesk at upstream commit 898e594
* Cloudron single sign-on, Cloudron mail relay for platform email
* Mailboxes on the Cloudron mail server connect over the internal network
* Mailbox wizard recommends Email password and hides forwarding, which needs an inbound route this package does not provide
* AI setup guide: hosted providers, NanoGPT, or private local models with LM Studio over NetBird
* App store description, setup guide and five listing screenshots
